request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and clear, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle drums, hopeful and serene, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A man who is blind and mute
Was brought to the Lord
He healed the broken soul
And opened up the door

[Chorus]
The kingdom of God has come
Right here in our sight
By the Spirit of God
He sets the people right

[Verse]
The crowds were all amazed
They asked the crowd to see
Could this be the Son of David
The one who sets us free

[Chorus]
The kingdom of God has come
Right here in our sight
By the Spirit of God
He sets the people right

[Bridge]
A divided house will fall
A kingdom cannot stand
If Satan fights against himself
Then how can he command

[Outro]
The kingdom of God has come
By the Spirit of God
